items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was so amazed at him playing three horns at one time that I could hardly concentrate on playing the piano.

ctx.x: You did “We Three Kings” and that also had Wendell Marshall on it as well as Charlie Persip.

And, you know, I was so amazed at him playing three horns at one time that I could hardly concentrate on playing the piano. I couldn't believe what I was seeing. I met a pianist once. His name was Kyle Perkins. He was out in Los Angeles.
